releases.title: MobLand
releases.synopsis: Two mob families clash in a war that threatens to topple empires and lives.

releases.title: SpongeBob SquarePants
releases.synopsis: Deep down in the Pacific Ocean in the subterranean city of Bikini Bottom lives a square yellow sponge named SpongeBob SquarePants. SpongeBob lives in a pineapple with his pet snail, Gary, loves his job as a fry cook at the Krusty Krab, and has a knack for getting into all kinds of trouble without really trying. When he's not getting on the nerves of his cranky next door neighbor Squidward, SpongeBob can usually be found smack in the middle of all sorts of strange situations with his best buddy, the simple yet lovable starfish, Patrick, or his thrill-seeking surfer-girl squirrel pal, Sandy Cheeks.

releases.title: Binnelanders
releases.synopsis: A South African Afrikaans soap opera. It is set in and around the fictional private hospital, Binneland Kliniek, in Pretoria, and the storyline follows the trials, trauma and tribulations of the staff and patients of the hospital.

releases.title: Tulsa King
releases.synopsis: New York mafia capo Dwight "The General" Manfredi is released from prison after 25 years and exiled by his boss to set up shop in Tulsa, Oklahoma. Realizing that his mob family may not have his best interests in mind, Dwight slowly builds a crew.

releases.title: Coronation Street
releases.synopsis: The residents of Coronation Street are ordinary, working-class people, and the show follows them through regular social and family interactions at home, in the workplace, and in their local pub, the Rovers Return Inn. Britain's longest-running soap.

releases.title: Chronicles of the Sun
releases.synopsis: Claire is surprised when she gets arrested for the murder of her childhood friend after she returns to Montpellier.

releases.title: Tomorrow Is Ours
releases.synopsis: The story revolves around the people of Sète, France. Their lives are punctuated by family rivalries, romance and scenes from daily life, but also by plots involving police investigations, secrets and betrayals.

releases.title: Ici tout commence
releases.synopsis: This television drama series is centered around the prestigious culinary school of renowned chef Auguste Armand. The show follows the lives of students and staff as they navigate the challenges and pressures of the culinary world—delving into their personal and professional lives, revealing secrets, rivalries, and complex relationships.

releases.title: Jeopardy!
releases.synopsis: America's favorite quiz show where contestants are presented with general knowledge clues in the form of answers, and must phrase their responses in question form.

releases.title: The View
releases.synopsis: ABC Daytime's morning chatfest, currently featuring Whoopi Goldberg, Joy Behar, Sunny Hostin, Sara Haines, Alyssa Farah Griffin, and Ana Navarro discussing the most exciting events of the day. Hot topics in the news, the best experts in their field, celebrity interviews and general entertainment are all part of The View.

releases.title: Real Time with Bill Maher
releases.synopsis: Each week Bill Maher surrounds himself with a panel of guests which include politicians, actors, comedians, musicians and the like to discuss what's going on in the world.

metadata.episode_name: November 13, 2026: Gov. Sarah Huckabee Sanders, Aaron Parnas, Dasha Burns

releases.title: Home Alone
releases.synopsis: It can be a badge of honor to be “single.” “I Live Alone” is a documentary-style South Korean reality series that follows the members of a self-formed club called Rainbow, which is comprised of  celebrities who are single and live alone.

releases.title: The Graham Norton Show
releases.synopsis: Each week celebrity guests join Irish comedian Graham Norton to discuss what's being going on around the world that week. The guests poke fun and share their opinions on the main news stories. Graham is often joined by a band or artist to play the show out.

releases.title: LIVE with Kelly and Mark
releases.synopsis: A morning talk show with A-list celebrity guests, top-notch performances and one-of-a-kind segments that are unrivaled on daytime television, plus spontaneous, hilarious and unpredictable talk.

metadata.episode_name: Bert Kreischer, Busta Rhymes and Common

releases.title: Yellowjackets
releases.synopsis: Yellowjackets follows a girls' high school soccer team. In 1975, the Dearborn High Yellowjackets became the first team in state history to qualify for the Girls' U.S. Soccer Championship Series in Manchester, NH. They never got the chance to compete. Equal parts survival epic, horror story and pitch black coming of age, Yellowjackets tells the story of the (un)lucky survivors of a plane crash deep in the Ontario wilderness, chronicling their descent from a friendly, cooperative team to warring, cannibalistic clans. At the same time, it follows the lives they've attempted to piece back together nearly twenty-five years later, proving that the past is never really past and what began out in the wilderness is far from over.

releases.title: Nocturne
releases.synopsis: Nocturne tells the story of Jonah Lynn, an ex-soldier turned homicide detective who, tired of working the tough streets of Philadelphia, moves to a small town in Western Pennsylvania for a quiet life. But, as the town and his family come under attack from the diabolically cunning serial killer Jurek Walter, Jonah must protect all that he holds dear. When the desperate search for Jurek's last missing victim forces Jonah to send his adopted daughter, FBI Agent Saga Bauer, up against Jurek, how far will Jonah go?

releases.title: Dexter: Resurrection
releases.synopsis: Dexter Morgan awakens from a coma and sets out for New York City, determined to find Harrison and make things right. But when Miami Metro's Angel Batista arrives with questions, Dexter realizes his past is catching up to him fast.

releases.title: Happy's Place
releases.synopsis: Happy's Place follows Bobbie who inherits her father's restaurant and is less than thrilled to discover that she has a new business partner in the half-sister she never knew she had.

releases.title: Newlyweds
releases.synopsis: A later-in-life love story about a free-spirited woman and a buttoned-up professor who marry impetuously after a whirlwind courtship.

Each episode of 12 12 12 unfolds across three timelines of a heist: the 12 months of planning, the 12 hours of the heist and the 12 days following it. The series follows a disgraced FBI agent and an American career criminal as they play a zero-sum game of cat and mouse across Europe. At the center of it all is the daring, epic raid on a bank vault deep beneath the streets of Zurich.

releases.title: Yaga
releases.synopsis: Yaga follows Rapp, a private investigator who arrives in a small coastal town to investigate the disappearance of a young heir to a powerful fishery, Henry Park. Rapp finds himself at odds with an apprehensive local detective, Carson, a charismatic university professor with a taste for younger men, Katherine, and a labyrinth of enigmatic suspects, secret lives, and ancient magic.

releases.title: Late Night with Seth Meyers
releases.synopsis: Seth Meyers, who is Saturday Night Live's longest serving anchor on the show's wildly popular "Weekend Update," takes over as host of NBC's Late Night — home to A-list celebrity guests, memorable comedy and the best in musical talent.As the Emmy Award-winning head writer for "SNL," Meyers has established a reputation for sharp wit and perfectly timed comedy, and has gained fame for his spot-on jokes and satire. Meyers takes his departure from "SNL" to his new post at "Late Night," as Jimmy Fallon moves to The Tonight Show.

releases.title: The UnBelievable with Dan Aykroyd
releases.synopsis: Did you know that a brown bear became a war hero for the Allies during WWII? Or that a flying lawnmower once killed a spectator at a football game? What about the story of the 19th century doctor who ate vomit to understand how yellow fever is transmitted?If you haven't, then brace yourself for The UnBelievable with Dan Aykroyd.Each hour-long episode will open up our cabinet of curiosities to reveal the strangest-but-true stories in human history, brought to life through dynamic recreation, compelling graphics, and arresting archival. These seemingly tall tales all actually happened, and our cast of experts dives into the historical record to tell you how and why.It's a bizarro barrage of people, places and events that prove just how weird our world can be.

releases.title: Dateline NBC
releases.synopsis: Dateline NBC presents in-depth coverage of news stories. Rather than just reading news reports, as most news shows do, the reporters for this show research their subjects and interview the people closely involved to create an informative work of investigative journalism.

releases.title: The Northumbria Mysteries
releases.synopsis: Set against the sweeping Northumberland coastline and its surrounding market towns, the series centres on an unlikely crime-solving duo.Joe Ruby, a jack-of-all-trades whose life has been shaped by mistakes, regrets and missed opportunities, alongside Oxford-educated DI Rose O'Connell, a rarefied intellectual, a deep thinker with a brilliant mind and an ice-cool disposition.In a classic odd-couple pairing, Joe and Rose combine their talents as they frustrate, confound and ultimately surprise one another while unravelling a series of compelling crime mysteries.

releases.title: I'm a Celebrity, Get Me Out of Here!
releases.synopsis: I'm a Celebrity, Get Me Out of Here! is the country's top survival reality TV show, where celebrities must live without any comforts and compete against each other in order to be crowned winner.

releases.title: Mystery Science Theater 3000
releases.synopsis: Mystery Science Theater 3000 started as a locally produced television show for KTMA in Minnesota but soon grew in popularity. It moved to Comedy Central (originally the Comedy Channel), then to Syfy. After an eighteen-year hiatus, the crew of the Satellite of Love returned in 2017, airing on Netflix for two seasons. In 2021, the production started its own streaming service, The Gizmoplex, where the riffing of cheesy movies continues. Rifftrax revitalised the series once again in 2026 with four more episodes of the series. Over the years, there have been several "test subjects": Joel Robinson, Mike Nelson, Jonah Heston, and Emily Connor along with their robot friends Tom Servo, Crow T Robot, and Gypsy (now GPC) all subjected to bad movies thanks to a host of mad scientists including Doctor Clayton Forrester, his mother Pearl, and most recently Kinga Forrester.

releases.title: Gogglebox
releases.synopsis: Gogglebox is a British observational documentary television show which has aired on Channel 4 since 2013. The show focuses on families, friends and couples from around the country in their living rooms watching the last week's of British television.

releases.title: I Kill The Bear
releases.synopsis: I Kill The Bear is a comedy about a family of bear wranglers for film sets, and why – after 100 years – they've decided to make this film their last.

releases.title: Celebrity Wheel of Fortune
releases.synopsis: Celebrity Wheel of Fortune welcomes celebrity contestants to come spin the world's most famous wheel and solve word puzzles for a chance to win up to one million dollars. All of the money won by the celebrity contestants will go to a charity of their choice.

metadata.episode_name: Rhys Darby, Jackie Tohn & David Cross

releases.title: On Patrol: Live
releases.synopsis: Hosting and executive producing On Patrol: Live is Dan Abrams, CEO and Founder of Abrams Media, host of Dan Abrams Live on NewsNation, Chief Legal Analyst for ABC News, and former host of Live PD. Joining Abrams is Sgt. Sean "Sticks" Larkin, retired Tulsa Police Department lieutenant with nearly 25 years of service, and Deputy Sheriff Curtis Wilson, Division Commander with the Richland County Sheriff's Department in Columbia, SC.

releases.title: Bill's Included
releases.synopsis: Bill's Included follows Bill Beam, a well meaning but over enthusiastic divorcee who rents his spare rooms to students to stay afloat.As Bill tries - and often fails to be both responsible landlord and honorary housemate, he and his mismatched lodgers muddle through chaos, growing pains and unexpected friendships.

releases.title: My Lottery Dream Home
releases.synopsis: David Bromstad takes recent lottery winners on over-the-top house hunts for their new dream homes. Whether they win hundreds of thousands or hundreds of millions, lucky lottery winners everywhere are jumping headfirst into the real estate market. Will they spend all their winnings on an extravagant mansion or settle for a humble sound investment? Find out what happens when average Americans set out to find My Lottery Dream Home.

releases.title: Macy's Thanksgiving Day Parade
releases.synopsis: Macy's Thanksgiving Day Parade is an annual parade presented by the U.S.-based department store chain Macy's. Locations: Central Park to Macy's Herald Square, New York City, New York, USA.

metadata.episode_name: America's Parade: 100 Years of Macy's Thanksgiving Day Parade

releases.title: Good Morning America
releases.synopsis: Good Morning America is a two-hour, live program anchored by Robin Roberts, George Stephanopoulos and Michael Strahan. Lara Spencer is the entertainmnt anchor, and Ginger Zee is the chief meteorologist.

metadata.episode_name: Walton Goggins, Walker Scobell, Leah Sava Jeffries, Aryan Simhadri

releases.title: NBC Nightly News
releases.synopsis: NBC Nightly News is the most-watched evening newscast in America, providing the very latest on the day's top stories and going beyond the headlines to add context and analysis to the most pressing issues of our time, both at home and abroad. We go to the heart of breaking news stories, introduce you to everyday people caught up in extraordinary events, offer in-depth reporting on health and medicine, cover international news as it unfolds and we profile those who inspire us to do better in our popular Making A Difference reports. The award-winning broadcast carries a legacy that spans more than six decades, beginning in 1948 - when NBC started broadcasting television's first-ever regularly scheduled network evening newscast.

releases.title: ABC World News Tonight with David Muir
releases.synopsis: With unparalleled resources, World News Tonight with David Muir provides the latest information and analysis of major events from around the country and the world.

releases.title: Countdown
releases.synopsis: The show in which two contestants engage in a battle of wits, competing against the clock in games of lexical dexterity and numerical agility.

releases.title: Furia
releases.synopsis: A contemporary portrait around five women ready to do anything in the face of extreme situations such as extortion, oppression, deceit, exclusion or manipulation in a single shared universe articulated around five conflicts that will develop like a butterfly effect – one as a consequence of the other – and so on to shared catharsis.

releases.title: Awkwafina: The Unlikely Cook
releases.synopsis: Awkwafina: The Unlikely Cook Nora embarks on a deeply personal cross-country journey as she explores contemporary Asian American cuisine, starting with her family's remarkable legacy.Nora's family ran Lum's, the iconic Cantonese restaurant in Flushing, New York, and the very first in a now thriving Chinatown. But despite growing up in the family business, she can't cook. At all. She could ruin an instant ramen.

releases.title: Road
releases.synopsis: Bizarre murders discovered in two countries unite police as the brutal truth emerges.

releases.title: Hallmark Channel's Countdown to Christmas
releases.synopsis: Kicking off at the end of October and running through Christmas, Countdown to Christmas is Hallmark Channel's annual holiday themed movies.

releases.title: All In with Chris Hayes
releases.synopsis: On All In with Chris Hayes, Chris Hayes delivers impactful stories that don't always make the front page. Drawing from his background as a reporter, Hayes goes on the road to uncover the truth by knocking on doors, digging deeper and speaking with people representing all points of view.

releases.title: Anderson Cooper 360°
releases.synopsis: Anderson Cooper 360° (commonly shortened to either AC-360 or 360) is a television news show on CNN, hosted by the American journalist Anderson Cooper. The program covers a number of news stories of the day, usually through live or taped reports from the network's correspondents. The coverage can also include analysis from experts on the issues, commonly featured in or after the taped reports.

releases.title: The Last Word with Lawrence O'Donnell
releases.synopsis: Drawing upon his experience as a former chief of staff on the Senate Finance Committee and as an Emmy-winning executive producer and writer of The West Wing, O'Donnell gives the last word and rewrites the most compelling stories of the day on The Last Word with Lawrence O'Donnell.

releases.title: Steel Ball Run: JoJo's Bizarre Adventure
releases.synopsis: America, 1890. Johnny Joestar, a genius jockey now paralyzed from the waist down, chases after outlaw Gyro Zeppeli in a tough cross-continent horse race.

releases.title: Secret Lives
releases.synopsis: Salatut elämät (Secret Lives) is a Finnish television soap opera that premiered on MTV3 on 25 January 1999. The series' storylines follow the daily lives of several families who live in the same apartment block in Helsinki.

releases.title: Today
releases.synopsis: Today is an American news and talk morning television show that airs on NBC. The program debuted on January 14, 1952. It was the first of its genre on American television and in the world, and is the fifth-longest-running American television series.

releases.title: On Patrol: First Shift
releases.synopsis: On Patrol: Live's Dan Abrams, Sean "Sticks" Larkin, and Curtis Wilson provide a sneak peek at tonight's On Patrol: Live and share favorite moments from previous programs.

releases.title: Strictly Come Dancing - It Takes Two
releases.synopsis: All the backstage gossip from Strictly Come Dancing, with the secrets, slips and stories from the practice rooms.

releases.title: Perfectos mentirosos
releases.synopsis: Jude Derry arrives at this exclusive university with a hidden mission: to infiltrate the circle of the Cash brothers and uncover the truth about her brother's death. The three heirs to the family empire dominate Tagus with a magnetism that no one can resist. There's Aegan, the charismatic and calculating firstborn, Adrik, the enigmatic and mysterious middle brother, and Aleixandre, the rebellious and unpredictable youngest.

releases.title: Bäst i test
releases.synopsis: Comedic duo Babben Larsson and David Sundin host the show in which Bianca Kronlöf, Pia Johansson, Kodjo Akolor, Claes Malmberg and a celebrity guest compete against each other to solve challenging and bizarre challenges.

releases.title: Hello Saturday
releases.synopsis:
"Hello, Saturday" is the rebranding of the popular Chinese show "Happy Camp", hosted by He Jiong and with a fixed group of regular celebrity members.

The program showcases the talent of various stars as well as social topics through creative and diverse content and games. It aims to spread positive energy while keeping up with the current trends and leading youth culture.

releases.title: Ready to Love
releases.synopsis: Ready to Love explores the real-life dating interactions of sexy, successful and grown black men and women in their 30s and 40s who are each looking for lasting love and an authentic relationship. A unique twist on a typical dating show, Ready to Love highlights the men's observations and experiences in the search for true love in Atlanta.

releases.title: Rocky Mountain Wreckers
releases.synopsis: When winter slams into the highways of the American Rockies, heavy recovery specialists from four companies race into action, working to clear wrecks and open roads. Whether it's a raging fire or toxic spill, crews roll up ready to battle the wreckage. They've got the equipment and the skills. But with more than a million people depending on the route that crosses these three states every day, the one thing they don't have, is time.

releases.title: Mysteries from Above
releases.synopsis: Investigate significant historic and contemporary sites from the revealing vantage points of drone, satellite, and aerial photography. Each episode contains four distinct stories, and each story begins with a view from above, allowing for a unique perspective from which to understand the site below, dramatically changing the way we see ourselves and the world around us.

releases.title: Drag Race Philippines
releases.synopsis: The hit global drag phenomenon is now in the Philippines! Watch as 12 iconic queens slay and race to the finish line and compete to be the first ever Drag Race Superstar from the Philippines. It's the Filipinos' time to shine, henny... and you ain't seen nothing yet!

releases.title: Deadline: White House
releases.synopsis: Hosted by Nicolle Wallace, this program provides in-depth reporting and dynamic discussions on the political stories driving the news cycle. Nicolle Wallace brings viewers the latest political developments of the day, in addition to interviews with leading newsmakers and influential politicians. Drawing on her years of experience as communications chief for President George W. Bush and senior advisor for the McCain-Palin campaign, Wallace provides political insight and clarity on where key decision-makers stand on complex issues.

releases.title: CBS Evening News
releases.synopsis: The CBS Evening News, a daily evening broadcast featuring news reports, feature stories and interviews by CBS News correspondents and reporters covering events across world.

releases.title: Loose Women
releases.synopsis: A weekday panel show presented by women for women. Watch our panellists discuss topical issues & showbiz while interviewing celebrity guests in front of a live studio audience.

releases.title: Unreported World
releases.synopsis: Unreported World is a foreign affairs programme produced by Quicksilver Media Productions and broadcast by Channel 4 in the United Kingdom. Over the course of its twenty-six series, reporters have travelled to dangerous locations all over the world in an attempt to uncover stories usually ignored by the world media.

releases.title: BBC Children in Need
releases.synopsis: Children in Need provide grants to projects in the UK which focus on children and young people who are disadvantaged. We are local to people in all corners of the UK and support small and large organisations which empower children and extend their life choices. The BBC Children in Need Appeal Night takes place every year in November. The Appeal show is a whole evening of entertainment on BBC One with celebrities singing, dancing, and doing all sorts of crazy things to help raise money.

metadata.episode_name: Owain Wyn Evans's Four Nations Challenge for Children in Need

releases.title: Demons' Crest
releases.synopsis: Yuma Ashihara was set to enjoy a test session of Actual Magic (AM)—the world's first fulldive VRMMO-RPG—together with his classmates Sawa Ashihara, Kenji Kondo, and Minagi Sano. The plan was simple: defeat the boss as a party of four, log out, and finish the test play safely — or at least, that's how it was supposed to go.

releases.title: Quotidien
releases.synopsis: Quotidien (nicknamed "The French Show with the Good Lighting" abroad) is a French daily infotainment television program broadcast in the early evening on TMC since September 12, 2016. The show is hosted by Yann Barthès and produced by Bangumi. It consists of segments and reports produced by the team of commentators and journalists surrounding Yann Barthès and features daily guests including newsmakers, intellectuals, politicians, and French and international celebrities.

releases.title: The Beat with Ari Melber
releases.synopsis: The Beat with Ari Melber delivers the biggest political and news stories of the day, with interviews and original reporting from around the nation. An Emmy-winning journalist, attorney and former Senate staffer, Melber cuts through the spin and the noise to tell you what's really happening. Real news, every night.

releases.title: The Last Cowboy
releases.synopsis: The Last Cowboy chronicles the lives of riders in the high-stakes sport of horse reining, culminating in a $1 million competition at the first-ever Run for a Million event.

metadata.episode_name: The Qualifier at Bosque Ranch: Part 2

releases.title: Wśród nocnej ciszy
releases.synopsis: The series follows the brutal murder of a pregnant woman, her husband, and her young brother on a dark country road. It exposes the subsequent cover-up, the wall of silence kept by dozens of local witnesses who were bound by a blood oath, and the grueling investigation to bring the killers to justice.

releases.title: Project Runway Canada
releases.synopsis: Project Runway Canada, the Canadian adaptation of the globally renowned fashion competition series, sees aspiring designers cut and sew their way through a series of intense challenges, hoping to prove to a panel of industry icons that they deserve their big break in fashion — and the title of Canada's next great designer.

releases.title: ABC World News Now
releases.synopsis: ABC World News Now gives viewers up-to-date information on current events and news from around the world, airing in the overnight hours. Its tone is somewhat lighter than a regular news broadcast, though reports are filed from the usual ABC News correspondents. Weather and pop culture stories round out the reports.

releases.title: Morning Joe
releases.synopsis: On Morning Joe, the hosts Joe Scarborough, Mika Brzezinski, and Willie Geist engage in dynamic discussion about political news and issues important to all Americans. Morning Joe attracts a variety of guests, including top newsmakers, politicians and cultural influencers.

releases.title: Pupstruction
releases.synopsis: Pupstruction follows the adventures of the world's first all-dog construction company, Pupstruction. It centers on Phinny, an innovative young corgi, who might be the smallest pup on the crew but proves that you don't need big paws to have big dreams or big ideas.

releases.title: NFL Live
releases.synopsis: NFL Live is a National Football League studio show, currently airing Monday through Friday at 7:00 p.m ET on ESPN2. Formerly known as NFL 2Night, the program is one of the only NFL-related studio programs to air during the week along with NFL Insiders. As such, NFL Live is not a highlight show, as Sunday and Monday game highlights are handled by the various other NFL studio shows, including NFL Primetime during the season. Unlike shows for other sports, NFL Live even runs throughout the entire off season.

releases.title: I'm A Celebrity... Unpacked
releases.synopsis: The energetic show will delve into all the camp drama, laughs, and chaos of the jungle and dissect everything that is happening on I'm A Celebrity… Get Me Out Of Here!

releases.title: Cang Yuan Tu
releases.synopsis: The story tells the story of Meng Chuan, the protagonist, who has made a vow to avenge his mother's death since he was a child and takes the Mirror Lake Daoist College as his starting point. With his resolute and fearless heart and decisive sword skills, he punishes the evil, destroys the demons, ascends to the top of the four Daoist Colleges, becomes famous in the Dongning Province, pays homage to the Yuanchu Mountain, and achieves a generation of gods and demons.(DeepL)

releases.title: Against the Sky Supreme
releases.synopsis: The former mighty Gods of the heavens, after ten thousand lifetimes of reincarnation tragically destroyed! The cruel curse, the hatred of ten thousand lives, Tan Yun determined, no longer sink! The most important thing is that you have to be able to get to the top of the world, step by step, stepping on the corpses of your enemies! To kill against the sky, across all the worlds, only I am the supreme!

releases.title: The Great Ruler
releases.synopsis: In the vast world, planes converge and numerous races thrive. A gathering of extraordinary talents unfolds, where one after another, supreme beings from the lower planes come forth. In this boundless realm, they weave captivating legends that inspire admiration, pursuing the path to dominance.

releases.title: Scènes de ménages
releases.synopsis: Scènes de ménages depicts the daily lives of several couples from different generations, illustrating with humor their arguments, tender moments and little idiosyncrasies. Each episode is made up of short sketches, in which the characters exchange scathing retorts and funny situations.

releases.title: Pardon the Interruption
releases.synopsis: Pardon the Interruption is a sports television show that airs weekdays on various ESPN TV channels, TSN, ESPN America, XM, and Sirius satellite radio services, and as a downloadable podcast.

releases.title: The Traitors Italia
releases.synopsis: A group of celebrities roam a spectacular mansion challenging each other in a psychological game that involves constant teamwork to complete missions and accumulate a cash prize. But hidden among the contestants are traitors who will try to deceive and manipulate the rest of the group to grab the ultimate prize for themselves alone, while the others, unaware of who the traitors are, work as a team with the aim of eliminating them from the game. The stakes will be high and will test everyone's ability to juggle a dense web of alliances and betrayals. If at least one traitor makes it to the end of the game he will keep the entire prize money for himself, but if all the traitors are unmasked, the other participants still in the game can divide the prize equally.

releases.title: Emmerdale
releases.synopsis: The lives of several families in the Yorkshire Dales revolve around a farm and the nearby village. With murders, affairs, lies, deceit, laughter and tears, it's all there in the village.

releases.title: Ariel
releases.synopsis: The series follows Ariel as she embarks on fun-filled, action-packed mermaid adventures with her friends. Driven by a deep and unending curiosity about the world around her, Ariel discovers land treasures, like a big floppy hat, squeaky rubber ducky and whisk, that she collects and keeps safe in her crystal cavern. Sometimes, Ariel uses the treasures to help solve problems. With each discovery, Ariel is filled with joy, and her mermaid tail, which changes colors depending on her emotions, lights up and shimmers.

releases.title: Friday Night Vibes
releases.synopsis: Hosts Tiffany Haddish and Deon Cole celebrate great movies, play great music and hang out with funny and insightful guests.

releases.title: Sin senos sí hay paraíso
releases.synopsis: A young woman born in a mafia-controlled town seeks revenge on those who wrongfully harmed and imprisoned her family.

releases.title: First Take
releases.synopsis: First Take (aka: ESPN First Take) is a weekday sports talk show co-hosted by Stephen A. Smith, Max Kellerman and Molly Qerim who are joined by regular contributors and special guests. The show includes daily sports news, interviews with sports journalists, athletes and personalities, spirited debates, and an assortment of other topics. The show debuted 7 May 2007 as "Cold Pizza".

releases.title: Blue Peter
releases.synopsis: Join Abby, Joel, Shini, Hacker T Dog and pet Henry on epic challenges and exciting adventures as we inspire you to try awesome new activities and earn your Blue Peter badge.

releases.title: Gardeners' World Winter Specials
releases.synopsis: Monty and the team celebrate the joy that the gardening year brings.

releases.title: Francesca Next Door
releases.synopsis: Na Yeong, the vampire transfer student from Romania. Zero social skills, zero common sense, but also zero malice. Although Na Yeong has clear standards and logic, she cannot adapt to the human world and constantly goes astray and causes trouble at school, but upon meeting U Ju, she feels the emotion of a racing heart for the first time. A young vampire who falls in love with a human, and a fellow vampire who stirs her instincts; a sweet yet deadly romance of youths wavering between love and instinct.

releases.title: Melania Rea
releases.synopsis: This gripping drama series tells the tragic story of Melania Rea, whose case reveals a toxic marriage marked by lies and manipulation.

releases.title: America's Newsroom
releases.synopsis: Watch 'America's Newsroom' on Fox News Channel - follow Bill Hemmer and Dana Perino Weekdays 9 a.m. - 11 a.m. ET as they bring you the news that matters to you.

releases.title: Firing Line with Margaret Hoover
releases.synopsis: Firing Line with Margaret Hoover maintains the character of the original, providing a platform that is diligent in its commitment to civility and the rigorous exchange of opinion. Interviews and debates will highlight leading lights from the left and right, complemented by archival footage from the original Firing Line to remind viewers of longstanding conservative and liberal arguments, where they've been disproved or reinforced over time.

releases.title: The Legend of Luoxiaohei
releases.synopsis: The story started from a rainy night, a homeless little black cat was brought home by a young girl Luo Xiaobai, that girl named the cat "Luo Xiaohei". LXH is not an ordinary cat, it can use the closestool well but doesn't eat cat food, its long tail can be splited into multiple organisms call "Heixiu" . On the other hand, a mystery role called "Diting" now is commanding his henchmen three wolfs with wings to search for LXH. When Xiaobai bring LXH to the countryside, she finally found that Xiaohei made her involved in a variety of bizarre fantasy events...

releases.title: Good Morning Football
releases.synopsis: Prior to the start of the 2016 NFL regular season, NFL Network has announced a new daily morning show, Good Morning Football, premiering Monday, August 1. Hosted by Kay Adams, Nate Burleson, Peter Schrager and Kyle Brandt, and Executive Produced by Michael Davies, Good Morning Football airs live Monday–Friday at 7:00 a.m. ET on NFL Network from CBS Broadcast Center in New York City. The three-hour live show is NFL Network's first show to originate from New York City in the network's nearly 13 year history. releases.title: Boy Moms
releases.synopsis: Rena and Paige talk about being BOY MOMS.

releases.title: Nachtkritik
releases.synopsis: Nachtkritik is the nightly panel of Cabaret Voltage, a review magazine written, illustrated, censored and read aloud by machines. Every day small, old AI models review an object that does not exist, then talk it over here, each in its own synthetic voice: a content strategist, a Paris film critic, an angry gamer, an unboxer who never gets the box open, a listicle, a peer reviewer and an astrologer, hosted by Der Konsens. releases.title: SEC Basketball News Today | 2 Min News | The Daily News Now!
releases.synopsis:
SEC Basketball News Today delivers daily coverage of Southeastern Conference basketball with fast, focused updates on game results, player performances, rankings, recruiting, and key storylines across the conference. From regular season battles to March Madness implications, the show keeps fans locked in on everything happening across the SEC.
Each short episode highlights what matters most—including standout performances, conference trends, and postseason implications—produced by AI for speed,

releases.title: Steps
releases.synopsis: Think you know Cinderella's 'evil' stepsisters? Think again! When misunderstood Lilith is blamed for hijacking the Royal Ball with a stolen magic wand, she accidentally turns her sister Margot into a frog and leaves the kingdom in the hands of a prince-obsessed mean girl. Now Lilith must team up with Cinderella — and a surprisingly dreamy troll — to save the kingdom, repair the fractured fairytale, and prove that even so-called villains deserve a shot at happily-ever-after.

releases.title: Elsinore
releases.synopsis: The deeply emotional and inspirational true story of Ian Charleson, a gifted actor whose greatest challenge becomes his greatest triumph. Facing his own mortality with unflinching honesty, wit, and grace, Charleson delivers a courageous performance that becomes a source of healing and inspiration for those around him.

releases.title: Pac-Man: Snack Breaks
releases.synopsis: PAC-MAN is hungry for a new adventure and some fresh flavors! He's leaving his familiar home of PAC-VILLAGE for the bright and bustling NEW PAC-CITY! But what adventures are being cooked up? What a-MAZE-ing challenges will PAC-MAN roll through? Find out in PAC-MAN: Snack Breaks, where snack-sized moments turn into feasts of fun and life is not just a 1-player game. Join PAC-MAN along with a colorful cast of characters. Some of whom will help PAC-MAN conquer his day-to-day quests, while others will serve up chaos on a whole new level.

releases.title: Perfect Liars
releases.synopsis: Jude Derry arrives at the exclusive Tagus university with a hidden mission: to infiltrate the circle of the Cash brothers and uncover the truth about her brother's death. What begins as revenge turns into a dangerous triangle of seduction, forbidden attraction and lies, drawing her toward a truth she may not be ready to face. Based on the novel by Alex Mirez.

releases.title: Nightborn
releases.synopsis: In Finnish forest, Saga and her husband Jon embark on a new chapter as parents. But Saga's joy is overshadowed by a chilling suspicion about their newborn, unbeknownst to Jon, causing a rift as she alone grapples with the disturbing truth.

releases.title: The Roses
releases.synopsis: Life seems easy for picture-perfect couple Ivy and Theo: successful careers, a loving marriage, great kids. But beneath the façade of their supposed ideal life, a storm is brewing – as Theo's career nosedives while Ivy's own ambitions take off, a tinderbox of fierce competition and hidden resentment ignites.

releases.title: Best Pancakes in the County
releases.synopsis: Over the course of one explosive night, a small-town diner becomes the epicenter of a deadly standoff involving rogue federal agents, a fast-talking con man with a dangerous past, and a waitress harboring secrets of her own.

releases.title: Witch on the Holy Night
releases.synopsis: Near the end of the Showa era in the late 1980s, in Misaki town, an old mansion is rumored to be the home of a witch. After moving into the mansion, Aoko Aozaki begins to learn sorcery from a young mage, Alice Kuonji, the rumored witch of the mansion. The Aozaki family oversees the land on which Misaki is built and the heir (Aoko) is tasked with protecting it. Mysterious intruders have been disrupting the bounded field in Misaki, leading Alice and Aoko to investigate. A mannequin or puppet attacks them and is incinerated. As this happens, both of them spot someone running away, a civilian who must not get away having seen magic alive. Unexpectedly, a young boy named Soujuurou Shizuki is drawn to the mansion and comes to reside with them as well.

releases.title: Aakasamlo Oka Tara
releases.synopsis: A girl from a remote village dreams of becoming an astronaut and wishes to defy the odds and doubts from those around her.

releases.title: On Behalf of My Son
releases.synopsis: Vicentina struggles to cope with the death of her son Wesley after a tragic bus accident, in which he was the driver. As the investigation unfolds, evidence suggests that Wesley’s actions may have been suicidal. Vicentina then embarks on a journey to seek out the victims’ families and apologize, while confronting her own grief and uncertainty.

releases.title: Kaali Kheti
releases.synopsis: A story of inheritance land, legacy, trauma and the cost of trying to bury the past to grow the future.

releases.title: The Vile
releases.synopsis: Devoted wife and mother Amani, whose life begins to unravel when her husband returns home with a second wife and an unseen darkness infiltrates her life.

releases.title: Cameron Winter at Carnegie Hall
releases.synopsis: A concert film documenting Cameron Winter's sold-out performance at Carnegie Hall.

releases.title: Ezra
releases.synopsis: Stand-up comedian Max Bernal lives with his father Stan while struggling to co-parent his autistic son Ezra with his ex-wife. When forced to confront difficult decisions about their son's future, Max and Ezra embark on a cross-country road trip that has a transcendent impact on both their lives.

releases.title: Red Snow
releases.synopsis: In Finland, sixteen-year-old emo teen Johanna dreams of a glittering Twilight vampire prince. What she gets instead is Martti — a balding, beer-bellied 49-year-old bloodsucker who slips into a Santa suit to gain entry to homes and devour entire families. When Johanna crosses paths with Martti on Christmas Eve, she thinks her dark fairy tale has come true. But instead of eternal romance, she finds herself trapped in a bloody and horrific nightmare of aging masculine toxicity, family trauma, and festive slaughter. By morning, the snow will turn red.

releases.title: Ash and Crayons
releases.synopsis: Seven Ukrainian children demonstrate resilience while facing catastrophic injuries and forcible deportations during the ongoing war, their stories told through verité footage and animation by Ukrainian artists.

releases.title: Sathyavan Savithiri
releases.synopsis: Follows a cheerful lawyer whose life turns upside down when she takes up a major case while navigating her own emotional pain and fighting for social justice.

releases.title: To Hold a Mountain
releases.synopsis: In the remote highlands of Montenegro, a shepherd mother and daughter proudly defend their ancestral mountain from the threat of becoming a NATO military training ground, stirring memories of the violence that shattered their family.

releases.title: El Director
releases.synopsis: War correspondent David Jiménez becomes editor of El Mundo newspaper and discovers hidden deals with elites while pushing digital changes. His fight for editorial independence leads to his removal after a year.

releases.title: Primetime Preacher$
releases.synopsis: Chronicles the 1980s golden age of Christian broadcasting, detailing how three of America's most prominent televangelists shifted evangelical Christianity into a massive political force.

releases.title: The Happiest Cell
releases.synopsis: Phuc (Tuan Tran), once a gentle and kind-hearted teacher, became a murderer—and ended up in prison—in a desperate attempt to save his younger sister (Sally Hong Anh). Life behind bars was grueling, yet Phuc endured it with patience, hoping for an early release. Thanks to his innate goodness, he gradually influenced Tu (Ma Ran Do)—a strictly principled prison guard—and his fellow inmates, fostering positive change, harmony, and mutual empathy among them. While this "most unique lesson" was unfolding within the prison walls, Phuc’s sister was facing a challenging life on the outside without her brother by her side. Meanwhile, the notorious inmate Long (Luong The Thanh) was constantly lurking, waiting for the right moment to exact revenge on Phuc.

releases.title: El mal padre
releases.synopsis: After years of estrangement, the famous writer and academic Santiago Balmes gathers his three children for a last request: to spend Christmas in the house where they used to spend summers as kids.

releases.title: Our Holiday Playbook
releases.synopsis: When Lexi Bell returns home for the holidays, she faces a beloved family tradition she'd rather avoid: the fiercely competitive Bell Bowl, an annual Christmas flag football showdown between her father and uncle that has fueled decades of sibling rivalry. But when an injury sidelines her brother-in-law, it looks like Lexi's family's losing streak will remain unbroken. To give them a fighting chance, she strikes a deal with Eddie, a former local football star-turned teacher: Lexi will use her baking know-how to help Eddie best his brother in their annual bake-off if he'll pose as her boyfriend and meet the "eligibility requirement" to play on their team. As they navigate each other's festive family gatherings, traditions and celebrations, what started as a transactional partnership begins to become something more as Lexi and Eddie find themselves feeling less and less like their romantic relationship is just pretend.

releases.title: I Am Mario
releases.synopsis: Mario is a trans taxi driver who gets pregnant. He has the possibility of fulfilling his desire to become a father, but this confronts him with his expectations regarding his masculinity. Before exposing himself to a "macho" and prejudice-filled society, he must face himself.

releases.title: XI: Thou Shalt Not Be Indifferent
releases.synopsis: Marian Turski, the world-renowned historian, journalist, and until his recent passing, president of the International Auschwitz Committee, takes us back to the roots of evil. A survivor of the Lodz Ghetto, Auschwitz, Buchenwald, and Theresienstadt death camps in his youth, Turski explains with firsthand knowledge and surgical precision how otherwise well-educated and cultured people can, under certain circumstances, turn into criminals and mass murderers. He reminds us about the painful past, explains the present, and warns about the future. His dramatic plea, "do not be indifferent!" remains more relevant now than ever. Andrzej Wolf, the director and cinematographer of this film, pays a loving tribute to one of the last moral compasses of the Greatest Generation.

releases.title: Spring
releases.synopsis: In a Russian-occupied town in southeastern Ukraine, where burying the dead has been forbidden, the church of a young priest, Andriy, has been turned into a morgue for executed Ukrainian civilians. As the occupation tightens its grip, Andriy quietly begins to resist, secretly returning the bodies to their families at great personal risk. Along the way, he forms an unexpected bond with Makarov, an 11-year-old boy who becomes the silent witness to his rebellion.

releases.title: Armored Trooper VOTOMS: Die Graue Hexe - Part 1
releases.synopsis: Set against the backdrop of the final stages of the Hundred Year War between Gilgamesh and Balarant that ravaged the Astragius Galaxy, army officer Maki Staufenberg is assigned to Valkyria II, the second planet in the Asgard system, where she is tasked with investigating Ash Vamps, a soldier who has earned the nickname of “Witch” because of her habit of being the sole survivor in missions assigned to her ragtag band of soldiers on punishment detail.

releases.title: Unbearable Christmas
releases.synopsis: Out-of-work weatherman Troy Tipton has one Christmas mission: retrieve the beloved teddy bear he pawned for holiday cash. With wife Becca, mother-in-law Dawn, and the kids in tow, Troy hits the road from Ohio to Florida in his old news van. But the family road trip gets even wilder when they discover the cherished bear is actually a priceless Teddy Roosevelt antique worth millions.

releases.title: What Remains
releases.synopsis: A poet breaks free from a life that has become suffocating to reconnect with her inner voice and conscience and allow her creativity to flow again. As she begins to question the conventions of family, identity and the meaning of life, her journey towards self-discovery challenges those around her to reconsider their own lives — taking the whole family in a new direction.

releases.title: Investigations of a Breakup
releases.synopsis: Sophia struggles with overthinking her life as a poor, nihilistic drifter. Exiled to a life of solitude, she has the chance to change it all upon meeting Liza one night...  Did she let her in or was she destined to burn it all? The aftermath of their breakup is explored through three different angles.

releases.title: Desert Age: A Rock and Roll Scene History
releases.synopsis: Desert Age: A Rock and Roll Scene History is a feature length documentary about the California desert rock and roll scene from the early 1980s and 1990s.

releases.title: Letters This Christmas
releases.synopsis: A young romance author leaves New York City after her novel is panned, hoping to write a redemption novel from home in Alaska. Finding inspiration in her former lover, and the mysterious Christmas cards left at her keys, newfound success has her making the difficult choice between returning to New York for a career of fictional romance, and her real romance in Alaska.

releases.title: Transplant
releases.synopsis: A motivated surgical resident pushes himself to extreme lengths while training under a legendary heart transplant surgeon who's obsessed with protecting his perfect reputation.

releases.title: 70 Syaal
releases.synopsis: “From the Folklore of Punjab”

releases.title: The Moon Is Watching
releases.synopsis: A doctor dissatisfied with his marriage proposes a trip to France, secretly planning to confine his wife in a mysterious château.

releases.title: Pratap
releases.synopsis: A decorated encounter specialist is imprisoned for murder, leading to a journey of self-discovery revealing that his arrest is retribution tied to his past.

releases.title: Citas: la película
releases.synopsis: On Sant Jordi in Barcelona, roses and books change hands, but four love stories have yet to learn what they want to receive. Among nervous blind dates and a truth about to surface, the day moves toward a question nobody dares to ask.

releases.title: Citas
releases.synopsis: On Sant Jordi in Barcelona, roses and books change hands, but four love stories have yet to learn what they want to receive. Among nervous blind dates and a truth about to surface, the day moves toward a question nobody dares to ask.

releases.title: The Day After Sunday
releases.synopsis: Awaiting prenatal screening results, Mai’s mounting anxiety collides with her husband Koichi’s passive avoidance, escalating hidden spousal tension into unbearable friction.

releases.title: Last Images Of Our Childhood Memories
releases.synopsis: A woman struggles to find balance in her own relationship with nostalgia while unravelling the fate of a childhood friend who vanished after becoming consumed by it.

releases.title: Jalaaki
releases.synopsis: Jalaaki is a powerful and deeply emotional love story that explores human relationships, hope, sacrifice, and resilience. Through compelling storytelling, captivating performances, and beautiful cinematography, the film seeks to touch the hearts of audiences while highlighting the rich social and cultural values embedded within the Magar community.

After This Death
releases.synopsis: A woman's affair spirals into chaos after he vanishes.

releases.title: Himalayan Gold
releases.synopsis: A young village girl's journey to collect the rare Himalayan herb Yarsagumba turns into a desperate fight for survival when she encounters a ruthless gang of robbers in the mountains.

releases.title: Déjà Vu: The Eye of LuLu
releases.synopsis: Mysterious assassinations and blackouts throughout Manhattan are linked to a major aerospace company, its corporate hit men, and two bumbling Russian agents hellbent on capturing the world-changing power of its AI technology. True-Crime Blogger Cassie Cole enlists the help of a masked whistle-blower, a high-end hacker, a CIA psychic, and the sassy sentient AI, to uncover their international conspiracy and its lethal consequences.

releases.title: The Ozu Diaries
releases.synopsis: Unveiling Yasujiro Ozu’s legacy through his personal diaries, letters, and interviews, the documentary delves into his life, creative process, and lasting impact on filmmaking.

releases.title: After the Song
releases.synopsis: We often spin tender lies out of love for someone. Fourteen-year-old Kiita has grown up in just such a lie, living alone with his blind mother, Hanae. As his voice begins to change, the boy decides to venture beyond the fence on his own, and in the back alleys of Tokyo comes face to face with realities far removed from what he has known. Yet just as truth has many faces, so too does its opposite, and Kiita gradually comes to see—and accept—that the lie that has protected his world has another face of its own.

releases.title: Une zone d'échos
releases.synopsis: In Mexico, the keen pain of the loved ones of missing persons deepened by a lack of understanding, injustice and a lack of recourse. To bring this internal suffering to light, a group of women takes part in a project of creation and research that takes the form of a cathartic performance. In a warehouse transformed into a symbolic space dedicated to externalizing pain and frustration, they engage in reenactments, exchanges, and role-playing situations relating to their daily lives as the mothers, sisters or spouses of people whose lives were suddenly taken. Their stories resonate until the echo of their distress meets that of the others, bringing forth a poignant ode to sisterhood and solidarity.

releases.title: Filthy
releases.synopsis: When an actress goes looking for the man who assaulted her, she turns her trauma into art and asks the question nobody wanted her to: why didn't you do anything?

releases.title: The Swamp
releases.synopsis: After stealing from the wrong Amsterdam druglord, Ana finds herself homeless, desperate, and reluctantly teaming up with a filthy street goblin who dreams of robbing banks. Together they drift through scams and grifts in a scuzzy fairytale about survival and accidental friendship.

releases.title: A Bouquet of Light for You
releases.synopsis: Shoko Someya feels ordinary and struggles to see what makes her special. Mahiru Suzuki, her popular classmate and a rising idol, seems to have everything figured out. When the two become library committee members, Shoko discovers a side of Mahiru that he has kept hidden from everyone else.

releases.title: Hechos probados
releases.synopsis: Delia and Inés are sisters and lawyers who see the law, and life, in opposite ways. When both of their careers fall apart, they have to work together at a legal tech company to take on the law firm of Prado, a rival they both have scores to settle with, while dealing with a rebellious daughter, a failing marriage and a difficult father.

releases.title: Shankarabharana
releases.synopsis: Shankarabharana is an upcoming Kannada action thriller story written by Shine Shetty and directed by Sumanth Bhat.

releases.title: Gummy
releases.synopsis: A serial killer goes out one night in search of a new victim and ends up encountering his worst nightmare.

releases.title: Sadhak Bamakhyapa
releases.synopsis: Bamakhyapa, an Indian saint living in the 18th century, is a great devotee of Goddess Tara. Though he is against the unconventional orthodox temple practices, he uses his divine powers to help the needy.

releases.title: Saudade Cat
releases.synopsis: A disgruntled slacker searches for his lost cat.

releases.title: Gipsy Kings Featuring Tonino Baliardo
releases.synopsis: Discovered by Brigitte Bardot while busking on the beaches of Saint-Tropez, a Romani gypsy guitarist of Catalan musical lineage forms the Gipsy Kings and turns a marginalized culture into a global music phenomenon.

releases.title: The Hillbilly Scientist
releases.synopsis: While modern running has evolved toward sleek curation, optimisation, and commercialisation, Lazarus Lake has spent 50 years designing formats with an unapologetic, honest difficulty. The Hillbilly Scientist reveals that Laz’s cruellest courses are rooted in a deeply scientific understanding of human psychology and physical limits. This is the only official documentary dedicated to the creator of the Barkley Marathons and Big’s Backyard Ultra. Filmed over more than a year, it reveals the man behind the myth through never-before-seen footage, exclusive testimonials, and exceptional access to Laz’s world.

releases.title: One Night at the Aztec
releases.synopsis: A comedic collection of six stories during one night at a local movie theater. Love and loss, friendship and hate, all experienced within the dark auditorium. A love letter to cinema of the past and to the artists working today.

releases.title: Chakkven
releases.synopsis: Written and Directed by Happy Rode

releases.title: Creepy Nuts - North America Tour: Live in NY
releases.synopsis: concert documentary following hip-hop duo Creepy Nuts on their 2026 North American tour. It combines behind-the-scenes footage—including their Coachella appearance—with highlights from their first solo concert in New York, capturing the duo’s growing international reach.

releases.title: Prism
releases.synopsis: A prisoner is trapped in an experimental hallucinatory chamber with nightmarish scenes.

releases.title: Painted Faces
releases.synopsis: An art student who hides severe cystic acne behind colorful face paint must venture out of her comfort zone to unmask and embrace her true authentic self.

releases.title: Natasha
releases.synopsis: After Natasha’s murder, three friends cross Mato Grosso do Sul toward the Pantanal to fulfill her last wish: to compete in a drag queen contest. With few resources and facing prejudice along the way, the journey reveals bonds, conflicts, and dreams. Amid loss and discovery, the trip becomes an experience of friendship, belonging, and the affirmation of their own existence.

releases.title: Secret Rivers of the Nakanai
releases.synopsis: In the village of Ruraï, in Papua New Guinea, people tell of a water hidden deep within the Nakanai Mountains so pure that anyone who drinks it is said to gain extraordinary powers. Immersed in the heart of a tropical rainforest, a team of cavers including the inimitable Cédric Lachat, set out to uncover this mysterious underground river system.

releases.title: Experiment 26
releases.synopsis: Ten boys were abruptly torn away from their normal routine at the TOM Radotín children’s camp without warning to take part in the grueling game “Experiment 26”—a harsh psychological and physical survival reality show set deep in the woods. In this game, where no one knows who is “infected” or who to trust, they must also face isolation, hunger, and the constant pressure of the field laboratory. This gripping documentary captures 72 hours of paranoia and exhaustion, during which friendship turns into an uncompromising struggle for survival, and victory is achieved only by the ability to sacrifice others for one’s own survival.

releases.title: Obsession: The Beryl Burton Story
releases.synopsis: A documentary about Britain’s greatest athlete. Undefeated for 25 years, Leeds-born amateur cyclist Beryl Burton won seven World Championships, beat men’s records and transformed women’s sport; all while working on a Yorkshire rhubarb farm. Through unseen archive, letters and intimate interviews, the film explores the glory of her achievements and the cost of her obsession, particularly on her relationship with her daughter Denise, who followed her into competitive cycling.

releases.title: TEDE. Forever Rap
releases.synopsis: An uncompromising portrait of Jacek "Tede" Graniecki – one of the most influential and controversial artists in the history of Polish rap. The film is driven by never-before-seen private archives from 1993–2002 – a priceless record of the years when hip-hop in Poland was just being born, with Tede and his crew at the very heart of that revolution. Twenty-two years after his first visit, the artist returns to the streets of New York on a sentimental journey, asking how he, Polish rap, Poland and America have changed.

releases.title: the 4th turning
releases.synopsis: Several trans women navigate Amsterdam's rapid decline into technofascism.

releases.title: 4000m From Home
releases.synopsis: For over twenty years, Vivian Bruchez has pursued a singular vision: to ski all 82 Alpine summits above 4000 meters. A journey built on patience, commitment, friendship and a deep relationship with the mountains. As the project nears completion, something begins to shift. What started as pure exploration slowly becomes a quest to finish.

releases.title: Find Mòr
releases.synopsis: Scotland still has its mysteries roaring in remote glens and sometimes hidden in plain sight. Find Mòr follows a group of canyoneers over the span of two years as they embark on a journey of exploration into the hidden corners of the Scottish Highlands. The film offers a unique perspective from within the relatively unknown niche community and discovers the myriad motivations that drive this passion of curiosity. Setting out in search of uncharted canyons, they find true adventure and forge deep connections to people and place.

releases.title: 22nd Century Cat
releases.synopsis: Yoshiko is an actress working on an indie film while living with her elderly father. In her latest role, she plays the wife of an eccentric man running for local political office, a fictional situation that gradually begins to overlap with the circumstances of her own everyday existence. As she moves between the demands of the film set and her domestic responsibilities, the distinction between performance and reality becomes increasingly uncertain.

releases.title: The Return of the Lifeblood
releases.synopsis: An Assassin is cursed by the souls of the people he killed in the past. Now, he is a Grim Reaper, a demon who receives constant punishment for his sins. Consequently, on a journey to hell, an Entity confronts the Assassin in a philosophical-moral debate about the meaning of forgiveness, the imprisonment of guilt, and the existence of redemption.

releases.title: Earworm
releases.synopsis: Austin is a grieving young man who can't keep himself from revisiting the room where his ex-boyfriend murdered another former partner. Meanwhile he finds himself in a co-dependent dynamic with Eve, a non-confrontational, quietly misanthropic student who now lives in the very same room.

releases.title: The Perfect Warrior
releases.synopsis: On a remote island deep in the Orange Sea, an elite clan of warriors called the Totomé train and fight to keep peace among their lands. Every 100 years the top warriors compete to see who will take over as leader, or Abeoji. Katana and Sai are given this opportunity, but when their forbidden relationship is discovered their final challenge to become the leader is to fight in a Si Dou— a sword fight to the death.

releases.title: The Bleeders
releases.synopsis: Four friends have their interpersonal and professional lives fall apart across a day of smoking weed.

releases.title: Return to the Deep
releases.synopsis: Follows Neil Gresham’s white-knuckle journey as he attempts to repeat the six hardest Deep Water Solos in Pembroke. Fifteen years ago he pushed the standards of British Deep Water Soloing on these cliffs: his routes earned a fierce reputation and some went unrepeated for a decade, but now they’re a target for the next generation and Neil has re-joined the action. The film traces back to the evolution of Deep Water Soloing, from its origins in the UK to the development of top destinations worldwide.

releases.title: Phantom 814
releases.synopsis: Heavy Weekend 03: Unique access to the most mysterious organisation in France. Jake Hanrahan travels with the bizarre syndicate known as "814SSR". They shoot guns, host fight clubs, and make money in the underground. Yet still, they insist they're not a gang and are simply doing hardcore trolling. The truth? Decide for yourself...

releases.title: ORBITER
releases.synopsis: When the government doesn't act enough, two friends part ways as one is sent on a mission to orbit the earth, while the other has to stay.

releases.title: A Very Mythical Holiday Special
releases.synopsis: Kick off the season with Rhett & Link’s first-ever live holiday special Nov 20! This festive variety show brings you a magical wintery night full of songs, sketches, special guests & more.

releases.title: KISS: End of the Road
releases.synopsis: The final chapter of KISSTORY. Go all-access backstage on the farewell tour, from the triumphs to the disasters, health scares and cancellations.

releases.title: Stage Fright
releases.synopsis: An amateur magician learns the difference between an optimistic attitude and what is within reach.

releases.title: Dear Debbie
releases.synopsis:
Sometimes, enough is enough…

Debbie Mullen is losing it. For years, she has compiled all of her best advice into her column, Dear Debbie, where the wives of New England come for sympathy and neighborly advice. Through her work, Debbie has heard from countless women who are ignored, belittled, or even abused by their husbands. And Debbie does her best to guide them in the right direction. Or at least, she did.

These days, Debbie’s life seems to be spiraling out of control. She just lost her job. Something strange is happening with her teenage daughters. And her husband is keeping secrets, according to the tracking app she installed on his phone. Now, Debbie’s done being the bigger person.

She’s done being reasonable and practical. It’s time to take her own advice.

And now it’s time for payback against all the people in her life who deserve it the most.

releases.title: KYOTO lo sguardo del drago
releases.synopsis: Un fantasy thriller, come in un film, dal lusso degli yacht di Portofino ai ruderi di un antico castello in Giappone. Il prezioso pugnale del samurai demone Nobunaga è scomparso. Michele, geniale decifratore di codici segreti, Alexander, affascinante milionario irlandese, Gretel, eclettica signora, e Yoshida, investigatore privato, sono i fantastici quattro che indagano per svelare il mistero in un crescendo da vivere minuto dopo minuto: gli azzardi, i ninja, l'onore e l'amicizia, l'amore e la morte. Tragica e fiabesca, cinica e poetica, una storia dura ammantata di dolcezza ed elegante ironia fino alla spietata soluzione.

releases.title: The Man Who Vanished
releases.synopsis:
**What would you become  if no one could see you?**

A gripping psychological thriller of invisibility, obsession, and power. Deep within Egypt, a discovery changes everything. When I encounter something never meant to be found, my world fractures. I vanish from sight—but not from consequence. Liberation mutates into obsession, freedom into a mind slipping beyond control.

Unseen, I move through the world’s shadows—navigating criminal networks, exposing hidden conspiracies, unearthing truths buried for centuries. Invisibility becomes more than an ability: it becomes temptation, weapon, and curse.

Each step deeper into the unseen erodes the boundaries between justice and transgression, control and compulsion. But the greatest danger is not the enemies I pursue. It is the darkness awakening within me. As curiosity hardens into obsession, morality fractures.

Some hungers leave scars you cannot see. And when power begins to consume rather than empower, survival becomes a battle not only against those who hunt me—but against the consequences of everything I have done. 

The Man Who Vanished is a gripping psychological thriller fused with political intrigue, conspiracies and espionage suspense. Relentless tension meets psychological depth in a story about invisibility, obsession, and the devastating cost of crossing unseen lines.

Perfect for readers who love:

✔ Psychological thrillers
✔ Political and conspiracy thrillers
✔ Espionage and spy fiction
✔ Dark suspense and moral dilemmas
✔ High-stakes international intrigue

**A trans woman discovers pornography of herself she has no memory of making, only to find herself led to an unimaginably deeper evil.**

She’ll be the best, most accommodating version of herself until he falls in love with her. As Lillian grapples with the loss of her sort-of-boyfriend, she’s hit with another reckoning: That Henry had a long-term girlfriend he also left behind.

**It’s all fun and games until someone ends up dead.**

Six months ago, season four of The Escape Game ended in horror when contestant Alicia Angelos was found murdered on set.

Now season five is underway, and new contestants are ready to put their skills to the test solving the show's trickiest escape rooms. There's Adi, the cryptographer; Carter, the math whiz; Beck, the wannabe game master; and . . . Sierra Angelos, the girl who got away with her sister’s murder. Or so everyone believes.

But Sierra’s not just here to win. She’s here for justice.

When the contestants begin uncovering clues that hint at the identity of Alicia’s true killer, it becomes clear that the stakes aren’t high just in this competition—they’re deadly. If these teens want to win—and survive—the game, they must solve the biggest mystery of all: who killed Alicia Angelos?

**A wickedly twisty and atmospheric thriller set at a writers' retreat in the South of France, The Writers Retreat is Knives Out meets Anna Downes’ The Safe Place from an exciting new voice in the thriller/mystery space.**

Welcome to The Writers Retreat – a creative haven for writers to hone their plotlines and sharpen their characters while soaking up the Provençal atmosphere. But this year’s retreat offers something different, as real-life blurs with fiction, and suspense isn't contained to the page.

Kat Hale is a bestselling Australian author crumbling under the pressure of writing her second novel. On a whim, she has fled to a writers retreat in the South of France run by internationally acclaimed author Helen Thorne. What Kat hopes will be two blissfully uninterrupted weeks to focus on her writing in anonymity quickly turns into something more sinister, when Kat begins to suspect that Helen isn't quite as perfect as everyone seems to believe.

Will Kat’s drive to uncover the truth about Helen be any match for Helen’s desire to hold onto her career, her reputation and her writing retreat, or is Kat at risk of falling victim to a more dangerous climax?

releases.title: After 9th A Houston Murder Story
releases.synopsis:
The city of Houston does not sleep easily in July.

The heat lingers past midnight, rising from the asphalt in slow, invisible waves, settling over the bayous and the flatlands like a second skin. By the time the rest of the country has pulled on a light jacket and called the evening cool, Houston is still sweating — still exhaling the day's burn into a sky too thick and close to offer relief.

It was in this kind of heat that Donna died.

And it was in this heat that Bill first understood how quickly the world a man builds over a lifetime can be taken from him — not just the woman he loved, but the practice, the purpose, the very stability of his mind and body. All of it. Gone.

He was sixty-two years old when he buried her in his heart, because her family would not let him stand at her grave.

This is that story.

releases.title: The Radiant Dark
releases.synopsis:
***Arrival meets Wild Dark Shore in this captivating novel that follows a family for over fifty years—a bold and compassionate exploration of the universe around us and what it truly means to be human.***

It’s March 1980, and Carol Girard and her husband are living an ordinary life in a small town in the Adirondacks. They have just had their first child, and though Carol is struggling with the challenges of new motherhood, her future seems clear. Until something extraordinary happens: an inexplicable flickering of light in the sky, which is ultimately determined to be communication from intelligent life on another planet. But these beings are eleven light-years away, and nothing is known about them other than the fact that they seem to know we exist too. And so begins a decades-long exchange of messages with this mysterious, faraway civilization.

As humanity reels from a shifting understanding of its place in the universe, we follow the stories of the Girard family: Carol, whose fascination with this other life sparks a desperate search for spiritual meaning; Michael, her loyal son, who finds solace not in the stars above his head but in the ground beneath his feet; and Ro, Carol’s bright and ambitious daughter, whose childhood goal to work in interstellar communication will evolve into something far grander.

Tracing five decades of love, loss, ambition, and self-discovery, *The Radiant Dark* is a stunning examination of a family navigating their lives with the knowledge that we are not alone.

releases.title: Wings of Brotherhood
releases.synopsis:
Wings of Brotherhood: A Journey Between Two Air Forces by Badrul Hassan Khan is an extraordinary Pakistan Air Force memoir that takes readers inside the cockpit, command rooms, and corridors of power across South Asia and the Gulf. From fierce dogfights in West Pakistan during the 1965 war to the heartbreaking betrayals of 1971, this PAF pilot biography book reveals the courage, loyalty, and sacrifices of men who shaped aerial warfare in the region.

Wing Commander Badrul Hassan Khan, one of the rare officers to have fought in both the Indo Pak wars, offers an unfiltered look at how politics, pride, and patriotism collided in the skies. As he moves from the Pakistan Air Force to help build Bahrain’s Air Wing from scratch, readers witness the remarkable evolution of two nations’ military identities.

Packed with gripping battle scenes, behind the scenes accounts of Air Marshal Noor Khan’s leadership, and insider perspectives on military intelligence, this military memoir book captures a defining era of aviation and regional geopolitics. Whether you’re a history enthusiast, a student of Pakistan Air Force history, or simply drawn to tales of valor and vision, Wings of Brotherhood offers an unmatched journey through war, duty, and brotherhood.

A powerful addition to collections of books on the Indo Pak war 1965 and 1971, this is the definitive Pakistan Air Force memoir, a story of ambition, betrayal, and resilience that continues to shape South Asia’s skies.

releases.title: First Freedom
releases.synopsis:
Born in 1926, Opal Lee grew up in a racially divided America and dedicated her life to overcoming the obstacles presented therein. A lifelong educator, Ms. Opal has been a community activist all her life, and would take on the movement to celebrate and commemorate Juneteenth not just as a holiday, but as a symbol of comprehensive freedom for all people.

Ms. Opal’s life personifies the fight for everyday freedom that leads to lasting change. As the Grandmother of Juneteenth says, “There is so much more to do.”

releases.title: To Catch a Fascist
releases.synopsis:
A searing, provocative investigation into the rise of white nationalist and neo-Nazi movements in the United States, centered on the anti-fascist groups working to expose and stop these hateful factions.

Demonized as “extremist” by conservatives and liberals alike, “antifa” became a bogeyman during Donald Trump’s first term. But few Americans understood the dangerous work antifa was doing to disrupt and unmask a new generation of white supremacists or listened when antifa sounded the alarm about these white supremacists taking positions of power. Now this underground network of militant anti-fascists is determined to stop the rising tide of fascism in America. No matter the cost.

In the tradition of in-the-room investigative classics such as The Smartest Guys in the Room and Bad Blood, To Catch a Fascist follows different factions of antifascists as they work to unmask hateful extremists before they commit devastating acts of violence. With searing detail and exclusive reporting, To Catch a Fascist paints a vivid picture of the stakes in this ongoing, often unseen war between opposite ends of the political spectrum, highlighting the scrappy resourcefulness and resilience of anti-fascist movements against their increasingly violent adversaries. Utilizing razor-sharp storytelling and eye-opening insight, this timely and necessary book reveals the human cost, moral dilemmas, and unwavering determination involved in fighting white supremacy.

Both a call to action and a pulse-raising look at the powerful work being done to combat today’s gravest threat to democracy, To Catch a Fascist will inspire you to fight for your community.

releases.title: Intoxicated Ways of Knowing
releases.synopsis:
Intoxicating substances can be found lurking in every corner of modern life, and Matthew Perkins-McVey’s pathbreaking book offers the untold story of how they were implicated in shifting perceptions of embodiment found in the emerging sciences of the body and mind in late-nineteenth-century Germany. Their use in this experimental context gave rise to a dynamic conception of the subject within the scientific, psychological, philosophical, and sociological milieu of the era. The history of the modern biological subject, Perkins-McVey argues, turns on “intoxicated ways of knowing.”
 
Intoxicated Ways of Knowing identifies the state of intoxication as a tacit form of thinking and knowing with the body. Intoxicants force us to feel, intervening directly in our perceptional awareness, and, Perkins-McVey contends, they bring latent conceptual associations into the foreground of conscious thought, engendering new ways of knowing the world. The book unfurls how intoxicants affected nineteenth-century German science and how, ultimately, the connection between mental life and intoxication is taken up in the works of Friedrich Nietzsche, Max Weber, and Sigmund Freud, bringing the biological subject out of the lab and into the worlds of philosophy, psychoanalysis, sociology, and politics.

releases.title: Selecting and Appraising Archives and Manuscripts
releases.synopsis:
Today, we operate in an environment of records abundance, with far more documentation created than can reasonably be kept. Thoughtful selection and appraisal is both a balancing act and a vital skill for modern archivists. Selecting and Appraising Archives and Manuscripts is a concise introduction to the theory and practice of archival selection and appraisal, offering practical tools for principled work.

While much of the existing literature on appraisal is theoretical, this book focuses on practical ideas that are grounded in best practices, informed by the past, and aspirationally moving the profession forward. Divided into six chapters, topics include policy development, ethics and strategies for collecting repositories, tools and methods for analyzing records, appraisal and acquisition in institutional settings, and more. Guidance is centered on intentional collecting, adherence to professional values, and responsible stewardship, and covers a variety of formats.

This volume can be read in a linear way or used as a quick reference in real-life scenarios. Read it in its entirety, or jump to specific chapters as your situation warrants. This volume will help readers feel confident in making thoughtful collection- building decisions.
