The story unfolds with calm intensity, showing how people live, love, and survive in moments of struggle and silence. Each scene feels natural and alive, written with care and purpose, reflecting the light and shadows of human nature. The author captures both the cruelty of power and the quiet strength of hope, allowing the reader to see how art can express what words often cannot. Shah Jahan is more than a modern drama book; it is an honest portrayal of what it means to be human, to feel pain, and still choose compassion. 

The writing is simple yet powerful, offering reflections that stay long after the book is closed. Readers who enjoy drama novels books and contemporary fiction books will find in it a voice that speaks to shared experiences and emotions. It is a story that values truth over show, meaning over noise, and hope over despair. Shah Jahan stands as a reminder that even in the hardest times, art can heal, stories can connect us, and humanity continues to seek understanding.

releases.title: Ubay
releases.synopsis: *Ubay is an observer from Astreon, a planet of perfect order, calm logic, and no emotion. Her mission: study the strange, contradictory beings on a blue world called Earth. She lands in the remote White Mountains of Crete, expecting to remain invisible. Instead, an elderly couple finds her, feeds her, and gives her work in their family taverna. As she works, she files meticulous reports on human behaviour, from inexplicable kindness to stubborn hope. But the observer is changing. When her identity is threatened, Ubay must choose between completing her mission and protecting the family who taught her what it means to care. This is a quiet, philosophical first-contact story about belonging, empathy, and the limits of logic, and it is the third volume in a trilogy that includes Ari's Taverna and Unheard Voice.*

releases.title: Burn Down Master’s House
releases.synopsis:
As turmoil simmers within a divided nation, smoke from another blaze begins to rise. Sparked by individual acts of resistance among those enslaved across the American South, their seemingly disparate rebellions fuel a singular inferno of justice, connecting them in ways quiet at times, explosive at others. As these flames rise, so will they.

Luke, quick-witted and literate, and Henri, a man with a strong and defiant spirit, forge an unbreakable bond at a Virginia plantation called Magnolia Row. Both seek escape from unimaginable cruelty. And sure as the fires of hell, Luke and Henri will leave their mark, sparking resistance among the lives they touch…

One is Josephine, a young, sharp, and observant girl who wields silence as her greatest weapon. A witness to Luke and Henri’s resilience, she listens, watches, waits for the moment to make her move.

Then there is Charity Butler, her husband a formerly enslaved man who proved his ferocity as a young boy standing alongside Josephine. At his encouragement, Charity fights for her freedom in court and wins – only to battle a deeply unjust system designed to destroy the life they’ve built.

And finally, there is Nathaniel, who ruthlessly exploits other Black people and mirrors the cruelty of the white men who, like him, are enslavers. A perversion of the system of slavery, his fragile and contradictory rule will become a catalyst of its own.

Inspired by the true stories of the profoundly courageous men and women who dared to fight back, Burn Down Master’s House is a singular tour de force of a novel—breathtaking in scope, compassion, and a timeliness that speaks powerfully to our present era.

releases.title: Whidbey
releases.synopsis:
Birdie Chang didn’t know anything about Whidbey Island when she chose it, only that it was about as far away as she could get from her own life. She’s a woman on the run, desperate for an escape from the headlines back home and the look of concern in her girlfriend’s eyes—and from Calvin Boyer, the man who abused her as a child and who’s now resurfaced. On her way, she has an unnerving encounter with a stranger on the ferry who offers her a proposition, a sinister solution, a plan for revenge.

But Birdie isn’t the only girl Calvin harmed back then. There’s also Linzie King, a former reality TV star who recently wrote all about it in her bestselling memoir. Though the two women have never met, their stories intertwine. Once Birdie arrives on Whidbey, she finally cracks the book’s spine, only to find too much she recognizes in its pages. Soon after, on the other side of the country, Calvin’s loving mother, Mary-Beth, receives a shocking phone call from the police: her only son has been murdered.

Calvin’s death sets into motion a series of events that sends each woman on a desperate search for answers. A complex whodunnit told from alternating points of view, Whidbey is searingly perceptive and astonishingly original. Exploring the long reach of violence and our flawed systems of incarceration and rehabilitation, this is a tense and provocative debut that’s sure to incite crucial questions about the pursuit of justice and who has real power over a story: the one who lives it, or the one who tells it?

But what she really wants to talk about are unhinged thoughts on gender, Karl Marx, Zionism, and her two great disappointing loves: an estranged trans son and a long-lost best friend whose betrayal haunts Barbara still. As she descends further into delirium and illness, Barbara finds herself in a nightmare from which she cannot escape, and her circumstances put her on a crash course with these intimates—or are they avenging nemeses?—once again.

releases.title: Friendly Pharmacy
releases.synopsis: Friendly Pharmacy is a slapstick pharmacy simulator for 1–4 players. Working solo or in online co-op, players decipher messy prescriptions, operate machines to prepare medicine, and get each order to the right patient as equipment jams and paperwork piles up.

releases.title: Ritebound
releases.synopsis:
2D platformer in which players must lead a group of cultists to a mysterious portal. On each level, the cultists must reach the portal, which may be located on the other side of a chasm, behind a series of obstacles, or high above their current position. Players will need to carefully plan their route and help the followers climb, jump over dangerous areas, and reach their destination.

Place boxes of different shapes to help the followers overcome obstacles. Set up trampolines that launch cultists into the air. Avoid enemies and sharp spikes to ensure that all the followers make it safely to the portal!

releases.title: Evil Maiden: The Noble Warrior and the Demon Armor
releases.synopsis:
In a war‑torn otherworld, the warrior Alice survives only by relying on her companions in the mercenary band. But when she returns from a mission, she finds every member slaughtered and her younger sister taken by a mysterious woman in white.

Driven by vengeance and the desperate hope of rescuing her only family, Alice dons a forbidden suit of demonic armor. In exchange for power, she pays a heavy price. Setting her feet on a dark path filled with blood, sacrifice, and temptation.

releases.title: Mystery of the Mysterious Futayuri Mystery Dungeon
releases.synopsis: Delve into the dungeon, fight against monsters, and get your hands on the strange relics of an ancient civilization, then sell whatever you find to build your fortune in this dungeon crawler RPG!

releases.title: Geo Book
releases.synopsis: Geo Book is a geography trivia game featuring nine different mini-game modes focused on countries, flags, capitals, cities, landmarks, and other geographical facts. Players can test their knowledge through various challenges, including timed quizzes, puzzles, matching games, and map-based activities. The game features a progression system with 30 unlockable ranks, as well as daily and weekly challenges. Online leaderboards allow players to compete for high scores, while Practice Mode offers a way to improve their knowledge at their own pace.

releases.title: Tidy Up the Flower Shop: Christmas
releases.synopsis: Return to the flower shop for a Christmas tidy-up. Sort 16 festive flower varieties, stock gifts, decorate the tree, and discover the notes left behind.

releases.title: Kintsugi Cottage
releases.synopsis: A cozy 3D jigsaw restoration game. Hundreds of shards lie across a cottage museum floor, and every glaze, curve and pattern is a clue. Work out which pieces belong together, rebuild the artifacts by hand, and restore the full artifact collection.

releases.title: Crazy Chess
releases.synopsis: A game based on chess. Solve 50 puzzles on boards of every kind and shape, with different types of tiles. Mechanics and rules that are a little crazy but a lot of fun.

releases.title: Interplanetary Farmer
releases.synopsis: Demand runs ahead of supply, growers are being recruited. You are one of them: you pick a planet, take over a plot of land, and run it remotely through a tracked robot called the Farmoton. You make money (nibs) by growing crops and selling them to the traders who dock at your farm's market each day.

releases.title: ReactorX 4
releases.synopsis:
The continuation of the adventures of the space saga "ReactorX"!
A robot technician and captain, flying through an asteroid field, receive a mysterious SOS signal with a "request for help." Tracking the coordinates, they are sent to an unknown mystical object in space. To get into the closed secret room, they need to turn on the power to the electrical system. There, a mystery awaits them.

releases.title: Snarkle!
releases.synopsis: Snarkle! is a dice game inspired by Farkle, set in a fantasy tavern populated by animal characters. Players roll six dice, keep scoring combinations, and choose whether to bank their points or risk another roll. Standard mode uses classic scoring, while Flavors mode introduces customizable dice with special scoring effects. Competitive mode lets players roll simultaneously and use random items to attack opponents or defend themselves. The game features shared-table local play, solo matches against bots, and online competitive multiplayer.

releases.title: My Friend's Hot Mom
releases.synopsis: Spend three days with a woman you shouldn't even be thinking about. Make choices, experience sensual scenes, unlock explicit illustrations, and watch a long-buried forbidden desire become all too real. Adults only.

releases.title: Whispering Eclipsia
releases.synopsis:
Whispering Eclipsia: Aakhiri Raat is a first-person psychological horror and investigation game developed and published by First Front Game Studios.

Players assume the role of Inspector Keshav, who investigates a mysterious death connected to the Woods Lane bungalow. As the investigation progresses, evidence, witness accounts, and supernatural encounters reveal a deeper mystery.

The game features exploration, evidence examination, character interactions, environmental puzzles, cinematic sequences, and a story-driven investigation set across Indian-inspired locations.

releases.title: We’re All In!
releases.synopsis: Experience minigame chaos in We’re All In!, an online party game for 1-8 players where you win by betting on your friends in a series of fast-paced games and challenges.

releases.title: The Heir's Guild
releases.synopsis: A turn-based RPG Roguelite where your choices will pave the path to victory! The Dragon Queen Tiametia threatens to take control of Realm... It is up to you, the Heir, to rally three loyal subjects to battle your way back to the Grand Palace and put an end to her tyranny.

releases.title: Noctis
releases.synopsis: Dive into an oppressive labyrinth where every step could be your last. Solve puzzles, survive the monster, and confront your fears in an immersive first-person horror experience.

releases.title: Arcade Warlord
releases.synopsis: A business strategy game set in the 80s arcade boom, where your company exists on the map. Develop hit games, deploy specialist Agents, move cabinets and cash across the city, and compete for strategic locations while managing the logistics of expansion.

releases.title: Meifu Kanshiki-Ka: The Underworld Forensics Division
releases.synopsis: You died at 4:44 a.m. Now you're the Underworld's forensic examiner. Rebuild the shattered memories of the dead with Picross, battle lying spirits, expose false testimony before King Enma — and find out who erased your own page.

releases.title: Beat Ten
releases.synopsis: Rhythm action sandbox that lets you use your local audio files or streaming apps to fuel the Beat!

releases.title: The Debtician
releases.synopsis: Buy items to gain debt in this level-based Credit Card deckbuilder game!

releases.title: Tanks Sweet Tanks
releases.synopsis: Tanks Sweet Tanks is a sugar sweet yet intense, fast-paced tank shooter game. It is fun, easy to learn, and addicting. Play alone, together with friends or against your friends.

releases.title: Wand Keeper
releases.synopsis: A cozy first-person organizing simulator where you pair 3,500 wands with their matching cases and file them across a two-storey wand shop. Read each magical stave, restore every pigeon hole, unlock helpful skills, or race the clock in Hardcore mode.

releases.title: Resettle
releases.synopsis: Resettle is a deep incremental city builder where you develop settlements on islands. Strategically place buildings to maximize resource production, explore 10 different upgrade systems, and create a thriving island city.

releases.title: Nightmare Conquest
releases.synopsis: Nightmare Conquest is a game focused on strategy, planning, and build creation. Assemble your team of monsters, position them intelligently, and evolve their abilities to face increasingly difficult challenges. Every decision matters — from the upgrades you choose to how you combine your monsters on the battlefield.

releases.title: Chigusa's Diary
releases.synopsis: Chigusa was just an everyday schoolgirl, but once she began to notice the boys, her life gradually started to change in unexpected ways...

releases.title: Football Survivors
releases.synopsis: THE FOOTBALL WAR HAS STARTED! Thousands of raging fans are storming the field. Defend against the fan invasion! 50+ unique heroes and abilities, 50+ upgrade items, position your heroes strategically, crush the waves of fans!

releases.title: Resequence: The Orchard
releases.synopsis: Resequence: The Orchard is an occult-horror adventure game in which school counselor Saito approaches an inexplicable phenomena through his counseling sessions with students.
